bounds: High-level helper closure is a navigation aid, not dynamic-call proof; virtual _beforeTokenTransfer is explicitly interpreted in wrapper action semantics.
External token and engine emissions depend on their implementations; downstream market/hook evidence is joined by the report producer.
Guard lists retain per-call predicates and have not been promoted into global invariants.
Source code alone does not establish deployed addresses, callers, multisig control or live engine configuration.
